title: Alarm Notifs Events
description: Alarm-specific properties for a notification event (such as BACnet alarm parameters).

priority.description: Alarm priority level (e.g. BACnet Notification Class priority)

notification_class.description: Alarm notification class identifier governing routing and acknowledgment behavior

event_type.description: Alarm algorithm or event classification (e.g. out_of_range, change_of_state, floating_limit, command_failure)

ack_required.description: Indicates whether operator acknowledgment is required for this alarm transition

message.description: Descriptive alarm text or operator message emitted with the alarm event
examples: Filter differential pressure high limit exceeded
